success_patterns: When a request specifies a result count and page position, map them independently to supported size/limit and page fields.

patch.reasoning: Two trajectories exposed missed pagination qualifiers: a request for the first 20 results omitted page 1, and a request for one card omitted page size 1. A targeted rule makes clear that count and page position are separate constraints.

edits.content: - Treat result count and page position as distinct constraints. Map counts such as “one” or “first N results” to the supported limit/page-size field, and map requests for page 1 or the first page to the page field when available. Supply both when the request specifies both.
